title.narrative: Quality Management in the Road Sector

description.narrative: " The objective of the proposed activities is to lay foundation for improvement of the performance of the roads sector of the Azerbaijan through the introduction of sound quality management systems that are accepted internationally and considered best practices. The outcome of the proposed activities will lead to more efficient operational processes within the roads sector of the country with a view to delivering better services to the road beneficiaries (road users, public at a large) public with a view to greater public expenditure management and financial accountability. 1. COMPONENT: Quality management to enhance public service delivery in the road sector The grant will be utilized to introduce concepts of a quality management system based on the ISO 9001:2008 AND 9004:2008 compliant (Quality Management Systems). This will include a review and assessment of the existing operational processes of the ARS for planning, programming, implementing and project managing through a client-based or beneficiary-based approach. This component consists of a diagnostic review, a development of a ""road map"", and assistance for its implementation in the ARS. The improvement of the performance in the road sector in terms of designing roads, executing operations and maintaining road network is considered as an important aid to strengthening state effectiveness and, hence, improving the governance, to deliver better services to the public. 2. COMPONENT: Establishment of quality management framework and quality management manual The proposed project will engage the Consultants specializing in quality management systems to assist the ARS to establish and institutionalize a mechanism for quality management framework and quality management manual. The development of a capacity building strategy and assistance for implementation of this strategy will also be included. TF096927 The objective of the proposed project is to introduce sound quality management system in the road sector in Azerbaijan in accordance with accepted international best practices."
